VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2026
  3820 CHERRY AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90807
  EAST ROOM, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Carlos Tec, Commissioner
James Goodin, Commissioner  Chad Vargas, Commissioner

 Members of the public have the option to email public comments to Veterans@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55858  Recommendation to receive and file opening remarks from the Chair.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55859  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the activities of the Office of
  Veterans Support.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55860  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, July 15, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55862  Recommendation to discuss updates on the 2026 Veterans Day event and, if
  appropriate, provide feedback on event planning.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55863  Recommendation to discuss updates on the 2026 Veterans Day Banners
  Reception and, if appropriate, provide feedback on event planning.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55861  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Page 1 of 2
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2026
  3820 CHERRY AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90807
  EAST ROOM, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Veterans Affairs Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Gina Overholt at (562) 570-4035 or
Veterans@longbeach.gov.
